properties.name: jwt.cookie.name.access
properties.description: Name of the cookie used to store the access JWT token.

properties.name: jwt.cookie.name.refresh
properties.description: Name of the cookie used to store the refresh JWT token.

properties.name: jwt.cookie.max-age-seconds
properties.description: Maximum lifetime of JWT cookies in seconds. Determines how long the cookie is valid in the browser.

properties.name: jwt.cookie.set-secure
properties.description: Indicates whether cookies should only be sent over secure connections (HTTPS). Should be enabled in production.
